fold_reason: First two panels in original order with complete undamaged U8000 initialization for every original seed; F0seed2 is excluded by the prohibition on repairing the damaged historical matrix. No new outcome used in panel choice.
question: With identical inherited U8000 checkpoint, sampling, updates, module shapes, frozen decoder LiDAR path and inference graph, does bounded frame conditioning improve critical pedestrian matches beyond an input-independent gate without worsening joint AnyMiss or materially increasing saved output burden?

gate.formula: w = w0 + a*tanh(output(hidden)); w0 = sigmoid(inherited static logits); a = min(0.1,w0,1-w0) elementwise
gate.initialization: output weight and bias exactly zero; same seeded other tensors in both arms; neutral reproduces inherited learned static mixture
gate.descriptors: Same actual float32 FPN/view/spatial and raw pillar spatial pooling in both arms; detach before trainable projections. Constant arm replaces pooled vectors by ones after pooling; both compute same projection/MLP shapes.
gate.novelty_limit: Original dynamic gate already used neutral initialization and conditioned outputs; only bounded probability residual plus tighter controls is new here, no priority claim.

decoder_lidar.primary: retained identically in both arms; 64->256 convolution, per-token LayerNorm times5, concat encoder BEV,512->256 linear+LN; all decoder-path parameters frozen
decoder_lidar.rationale: Controls architecture and parameter differences without removing a path from a warm-started detector; primary contrast is incremental conditioning conditional on this shared path, not path-free gate efficacy.
decoder_lidar.diagnostic: At fixed final and neutral checkpoints only, zero decoder LiDAR half immediately before lidar_fuse_linear; still compute projection/normalization and fusion. This is an inference intervention, not retrained control or causal efficacy.

training.selection: No new checkpoint or candidate selection; predetermined U8000 from each same-fold same-seed history; final600 only. No development/outer endpoint is used to choose a model.
training.stage_A: gate only, AdamW lr1e-4 wd0.01 clip35; others frozen including BN
training.stage_B: gate lr1e-4, encoder lr1e-5, AdamW wd0.01 clip35; head/backbone/neck/LiDAR/decoder frozen; BN frozen
training.sampler: Original uniform repeated seeded permutations over identical existing fold training data; stage A seed=base+100 then indices(seed+10000); stage B seed=base+200 then indices(seed+20000)
training.randomness: Original perstep seeds: A=(base+100)*1000000+200000+i; B=(base+200)*1000000+300000+i; reset before each dataset draw and forward, identical between arms; TF32 false; no bitwise CUDA claim.
training.checkpoint_storage: Final model state only and immutable step log; no resume, no automatic retry, no old launcher or dispatcher

evaluation.primary: clean outer panel, bothfolds pooled within each seed; dynamic minus constant critical pedestrian recall
evaluation.roles: Existing train/development/outer scene/log roles unmodified; no new monitor or calibration fitting; all boxes uncalibrated. Historical mini exposure remains.
evaluation.neutral_reference: One shared untrained initialized gate/checkpoint per fold/seed, outer_clean and outer_clean_decoder_lidar_zero only; reference is not an equal-update comparator
evaluation.matching: Preserve frozen custom failure_event semantics: mapped all-positive-sensor GT, score descending then lexicographic decimal prediction slot as tie; nearest unassigned sameclass eligible GT, strictdist<2m; only then critical ROI. Original GT annotation order breaks equal distance ties. SDK metrics remain separate.
evaluation.identity: Persist sample/scene/log, annotation and instance tokens, GT eligibility/critical flag/class/egoXY, match prediction ID/slot/distance/score and prediction-file SHA; prediction IDs run/sample/slot, no crossrun tracking claim.
secondary: exact target recoveries/losses/persistent misses/matches and sameframe exchanges
fully recovered and newly failed frames
saved ped/allclass outputs>=0.1 and allrange unmatched ped counts, not officialFP/precision
gate range/deviation and decoder-path intervention sensitivity
evaluation.minimum_useful_effect: Dynamic improves pooled critical pedestrian recall by at least1.0 percentage point over constant in EACH original seed on the fixed panel; joint AnyMiss failures do not increase in any seed; no negative equal-log pedestrian effect in any seed; saved pedestrian output count increases by at most5% in everyseed. Criterion is descriptive, not statistical confirmation or a driving requirement.
evaluation.stop_rule: Finish fixed comparisons regardless of sign; if criterion fails, stop candidate expansion. No selected seed/fold/condition replaces primary; no additional optimization, tuning, stronger candidate or fresh-data claim. Unsupported classes remain null.

budget.failure_rule: Any nonfinite loss/gradient, mismatched parent/role/sampler/shared initialization, unexpected training module, OOM, conflicting compute, exceeded limit or unaccounted process stops affected stage; preserve failure and costs, no automatic retry. Up to one explicitly versioned engineering repair within total3engineeringupdates and30minutes before scientific runs. No scientific retry after optimizer updates.

evidence_limit: Historically exposed mini; two folds/six trained replicas reuse the same four outer logs. Sameprocess AI review is not external independent replication; no iidframe CI/pvalue, causal/SOTA/calibratedsafety/collisionrisk/externalgeneralization claim.
